Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides

PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of The Chief Inspector of Naval Armament A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The kilometers not used during a particular day shall be carried over to the next day and extra kilometers if any, traveled during next day will be adjusted against these unused kilometers. 2. The payment will be made by AAO (Navy), Kochi within 90 days (approximate) are to submitting or re- submitting the bill except for the bill submitted or re-submitted in the month of Mar where the clearance of bill may get delayed for more than 90 days. 3. The rate to be quoted including all taxes and levies. 4. The vehicle is to be reported atleast 10 minutes before time given in supply order. 5. In case of delay beyond 30 minutes from the time mention in the supply order, proportionate amount for the delayed period will be deducted from the daily fare. 6. In case of breakdown of any vehicle during transit, the replacement vehicle as per supply order need t o be positioned within one hour. 7. The service provider should have a registered office at Trivandrum district of Keralam state. (Docume ntary evidence to be submitted. . 9.
